user_prompt: In adults with heart disease, what is the effect of home-based cardiac rehabilitation (including digital/telehealth-supported programmes) versus supervised centre-based cardiac rehabilitation on triglycerides at 3–12 months follow-up?  Evaluate ONLY triglycerides. Use the latest eligible follow-up between 3 and 12 months and convert triglyceride values to mmol/L when necessary using a valid universal conversion factor. Extract arm-level mean, SD, and N; either absolute follow-up values or change-from-baseline values are acceptable, whichever the paper reports, and do not exclude a study solely because it reports change scores. If only median/IQR is reported, estimate mean/SD using Wan et al. (2014). For multi-arm trials, extract each eligible home-based intervention vs shared centre-based control comparison separately. Exclude usual-care/waitlist/non-centre comparators, protocols, non-RCTs, and all outcomes other than triglycerides.
